course_points.n: Turn slight right onto Grote Oost

points_of_interest.name: Zaanse Schans
points_of_interest.description: Historic windmills and Zaan heritage area; worthwhile short scenic detour from the route. Category: scenic / historic. Approx route km 6.0; on/very near track. Source: https://www.zaanseschans.com/en/contact/

points_of_interest.name: Cafe De Lepelaar, Jisp
points_of_interest.description: Cafe-restaurant at Molenpad 2 in Jisp; good independent mid-ride stop, check opening days. Category: food / cafe. Approx route km 12.3; on/very near track. Source: https://www.delepelaarjisp.nl/contact/

points_of_interest.name: Neckermolen
points_of_interest.description: Historic windmill near Neck/Wijdewormer; useful landmark in the open polder section. Category: historic / windmill. Approx route km 17.5; about 0.4 km from track. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Neckermolen,_Neck

points_of_interest.name: Koemarkt, Purmerend
points_of_interest.description: Central Purmerend square with cafes and restaurants; practical mid-route break option. Category: food / rest. Approx route km 19.4; about 0.4 km from track. Source: https://community.openstreetmap.org/t/is-hier-iemand-uit-purmerend-ik-ben-blind-ik-wil-in-mei-naar-de-kermis-te-komen-en-ik-heb-specifieke-hulp-van-osm-users-met-co%C3%B6rdinaten-nodig/125567

points_of_interest.name: Fort aan de Nekkerweg
points_of_interest.description: UNESCO Defence Line fort, now Fort Resort Beemster; optional heritage/service detour. Category: historic / optional detour. Approx route km 21.3; about 1.9 km from track. Source: https://www.laagholland.com/locaties/1167940948/fort-aan-de-nekkerweg

points_of_interest.name: Fort benoorden Purmerend
points_of_interest.description: Defence Line of Amsterdam fort near the route; heritage point, access may be limited/private. Category: historic. Approx route km 22.2; about 0.3 km from track. Source: https://defensiefotografie.nl/mob-complex/mmc/purmerend/

points_of_interest.name: Kwadijk Village
points_of_interest.description: Small village waypoint after Purmerend; useful orientation point before the open rural stretch. Category: village / navigation. Approx route km 22.8; about 1.8 km from track. Source: https://www.laengengrad-breitengrad.de/gps-koordinaten-von-kwadijk

points_of_interest.name: Grote Kerk Oosthuizen
points_of_interest.description: Late-Gothic village church and clear skyline landmark near the Beemster edge. Category: historic / landmark. Approx route km 28.5; on/very near track. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Hervormde_Kerk,_Oosthuizen

points_of_interest.name: Beets Village
points_of_interest.description: Quiet village waypoint in the rural section; helpful for pacing and regrouping. Category: village / rest. Approx route km 30.5; about 1.5 km from track. Source: https://www.werelate.org/wiki/Place:Beets,_Noord-Holland,_Netherlands

points_of_interest.name: Westfriese Omringdijk View
points_of_interest.description: On-route dike viewpoint area approaching Hoorn; open landscape and former Zuiderzee dike character. Category: scenic / viewpoint. Approx route km 35.0; on/very near track. Source: https://www.nederlandfietsland.nl/fietsroute/westfriese-omringdijk/

points_of_interest.name: Hoorn Station
points_of_interest.description: Rail connection near the route finish; useful bailout or return-travel waypoint. Category: train / bailout. Approx route km 40.3; about 0.3 km from track. Source: https://trainstracking.com/stations/hoorn-netherlands-stoparea18110

points_of_interest.name: Roode Steen, Hoorn
points_of_interest.description: Historic central square with restaurants and Westfries Museum area; good finish-area stop. Category: food / historic center. Approx route km 41.1; about 0.2 km from track. Source: https://www.coordinatenbepalen.nl/coordinates/1084770-de-roode-steen-hoorn

points_of_interest.name: Hoofdtoren, Hoorn Harbor
points_of_interest.description: Historic harbor tower at Hoofd 2; scenic finish-area landmark by the water. Category: scenic / historic. Approx route km 41.4; on/very near track. Source: https://www.vuurtorens.org/vuurtoren/hoorn-hoofdtoren/
